Description: Customer credit card information.
Fields:

  - expmonth (smallint(16,0)): The month when the credit card expires and is no longer valid for transactions
  - cardtype (character varying(50)): The brand or network of the credit card, such as Visa, MasterCard, American Express, or Discover
  - creditcardid (integer(32,0)) [PK]: Unique identifier for the credit card record in the system, used as a reference key for linking to customer orders
